Update layer options of a myIO chart in place from the Shiny server

Source: R/myIOProxy.R
updateMyIOOptions.Rd

`updateMyIOOptions()` merges new options into one or more existing layers of a rendered chart and redraws it, without re-running `renderMyIO()`. Only the supplied option names change; every other option keeps its current value.

Usage

updateMyIOOptions(proxy, ...)

Arguments

proxy

A `myIO_proxy` object from [myIOProxy()].

...

One or more `label = list(...)` updates, where `label` is an existing layer label and the list holds the option names and new values.

Value

The proxy, invisibly.

Details

Each chart type decides what to keep across the redraw. A field chart keeps its playback time, play state, speed, selected player, hidden teams, labels, trail length and metric window when the update leaves `pitchLength`, `pitchWidth` and `maxGap` unchanged; a new `metricWindow` replaces the kept window. Changing pitch size or `maxGap` starts the field chart over. Other chart types redraw from the new options.

Layers are matched by their `label`. Unknown labels are ignored client-side. Field options (`overlays`, `minPlayers`, `excludeEntities`, `metricWindow`, `events`) are checked the same way `addIoLayer()` checks them.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
observeEvent(input$overlays, {
  myIOProxy("field") |>
    updateMyIOOptions(match = list(overlays = list(shape = "shape" %in% input$overlays)))
})
} # }
